lines.t: When the road feels rough beneath my feet
And the world turns cold when strangers meet
Your voice reminds me
Gentle and true
Do for them
What they do for you
Love is the language heaven speaks
It lifts the lowly, guards the weak
Treat others as you
Would have him treat you, walk in mercy, let kindness break through.
In every heart, let his love shine bright.
Do what is good, do what is right.
When anger burns and temper rises
I see your grace through weary eyes
Forgiveness whispers, start anew
Do for them what they do for you
Faith is action born of grace
Compassion marks the righteous place
Treat others as you
Who would have them treat you?
Walk in mercy
Let kindness break through
And every heart let His love shine bright Do what is good, do what is right
In love there's no law we can't fulfill When hearts align with the Father's will
The measure you give we'll return to
A pressed down blessing running through
Treat others as you would have them treat you
Walk in mercy, let kindness break through
Do for them what He's done for you Do for them what He's done for you
The golden rule, forever true
